 Subscribe I confirm I am 21+ years of age Link The UCLA Bruins (4-0) will look to build on a four-game winning streak when they host the CSU Fullerton Titans (2-1) on November 18, 2026 at Pauley Pavilion.
 Before you place your bet on this game at FanDuel Sportsbook, here are the NCAA basketball odds and spreads you need to know.
 UCLA vs. CSU Fullerton Game Info and Odds
 Game day: Wednesday, November 18, 2026
 Game time: 10:30 p.m. ET
 TV channel: Big Ten Network
 Location: Los Angeles, California
 Arena: Pauley Pavilion
 Take a look at these betting trends and insights before you bet on Wednesday's UCLA-CSU Fullerton spread (UCLA -30.5) or over/under (166.5 points).
 Sign up for FanDuel Sportsbook and FanDuel Daily Fantasy today! 
 UCLA vs. CSU Fullerton: ATS Betting Stats and Trends
 UCLA put together a 16-20-0 record against the spread last season.
 CSU Fullerton won 20 games against the spread last year, while failing to cover 11 times.
 The Bruins covered the spread in a higher percentage of their home games than away games last season. They covered 10 times in 18 opportunities when playing at home, and they covered three times in 10 opportunities in away games.
 The Titans' winning percentage against the spread at home last year was .750 (9-3-0). On the road, it was .500 (8-7-0).
 UCLA vs. CSU Fullerton: Moneyline Betting Stats
 UCLA finished with a 19-3 record in games it was listed as the moneyline favorite last season (winning 86.4% of those games).
 The Bruins never played a game last season with moneyline odds of -100000 or shorter.
 Last season, CSU Fullerton was the underdog 21 times and won seven, or 33.3%, of those games.
 The Titans were not a bigger underdog last season than the +8000 moneyline set for this game.
 UCLA has an implied moneyline win probability of 99.9% in this contest.
 UCLA vs. CSU Fullerton Head-to-Head Comparison
 Last season, UCLA was 144th in the country on offense (77.1 points scored per game) and 101st defensively (71.1 points conceded).
 UCLA grabbed 29.3 rebounds per game and gave up 30.4 boards last season, ranking 309th and 130th, respectively, in the country.
 With 16.1 assists per game last year, UCLA was 51st in the country.
 In terms of turnovers, UCLA was fifth-best in the nation in committing them (8.3 per game) last season. It was 119th in forcing them (11.7 per game).
 CSU Fullerton's defensive performance was 16th-worst in college basketball last year with 81.7 points allowed per contest, but offensively it played better, scoring 83 points per game (33rd-ranked in college basketball).
 CSU Fullerton ranked 12th-worst in college basketball with 35 rebounds allowed per game. Meanwhile, it grabbed 31.6 rebounds per game (205th-ranked in college basketball).
 CSU Fullerton put up 16.1 dimes per game, which ranked them 51st in the nation.
 CSU Fullerton committed 10.9 turnovers per game last year (189th-ranked in college basketball), and it forced 14.5 turnovers per game (seventh-best).
